items.title: Pay annual gas bill balance
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Start of period is the invoice date 27.11.2026; under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 30-calendar-day period runs from 28.11.2026. Counting 30 calendar days from 27.11.2026 lands on 27.12.2026 (3 remaining days in November [28,29,30] + 27 days in December = 27.12.2026). This is a payment owed to a company, so § 193 BGB applies using the payer's own Land (NW). 27.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to the next working day. 28.12.2026 (Monday) is not a public holiday in NW, so the payment is due then.
